card.name: Start of the word schizophrenia in headings
card.fires_on: The first piece "Sch" of the word schizophrenia when it begins a section heading or table label. It is most often right after a section number like 2.2 in dosage sections.

modes.label: Numbered section heading
modes.description: "Sch" opening a heading just after a section number such as 2.1 or 2.2.
modes.example: 2.2<< Sch>>izophrenia The recommended dose of asen

modes.label: Population or table label
modes.description: "Sch" opening the word after phrases like Adults or Patients with, in trial tables or subgroup labels.
